definitions.explanation: Differences or variations between individuals. Commonly used when noting that results, effects, or experiences may vary from person to person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個人差|こじんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効|き}き{目|め}→効き目：19884_kikime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個人差|こじんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The effectiveness of the medicine varies greatly between individuals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{個人差|こじんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べなくて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The speed of growth varies between individuals, so there's no need to compare with other children.

notes:
A very common phrase in medical, health, and product contexts. The standard disclaimer {個人差|こじんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧ ("individual results may vary") appears frequently in advertisements, medical explanations, and product descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人差|こじんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there are individual differences)
- {個人差|こじんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (there is great individual variation)
- {個人差|こじんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}する→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧ (take individual differences into account)

The word is composed of ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧ (individual) + ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference). Similar compound words include {年齢差|ねんれいさ} (age difference) and ⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧ (disparity).
